description: extract_sig_header first calls str::from_utf8 on the header section, then iterates line-by-line over the resulting &str. This is fine but the UTF-8 check also runs on the body bytes that were already excluded by body_start. The code correctly slices with header_section = &article_bytes[..body_start.unwrap_or(len)] before the UTF-8 check, so the body is excluded. No real efficiency problem here -- already correct. Withdraw this issue.
title: verify: x_sig extract_sig_header does two passes over header section (UTF-8 decode + line scan)
